name: Zarna Garg
bio: Zarna Garg (born February 15, 1975) is an Indian-American stand-up comedian, actress and screenwriter. She is also a New York Times bestselling author. She earned a bachelor's degree in finance from the University of Akron, and a Juris Doctor degree from the Case Western Reserve University School of Law. After being a stay-at-home mother for 16 years, she was encouraged by her children to try stand-up comedy.

credits.title: Clashing Through the Snow
credits.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

credits.title: Zarna Garg: Practical People Win
credits.overview: Zarna Garg is bringing the heat (and the guilt trips) in her laugh-out-loud Hulu debut, taking aim at husbands, kids, in-laws, and anyone who dares question an Indian mom's wisdom.

credits.title: A Nice Indian Boy
credits.overview: When Naveen brings his fiancé Jay home to meet his traditional Indian family, they must contend with accepting his white-orphan-artist boyfriend and helping them plan the Indian wedding of their dreams.

credits.title: Zarna Garg: One in a Billion
credits.overview: Zarna Garg's taking the comedy world by storm with her first streaming stand-up special. As an unapologetic, Indian-Immigrant mom, she has plenty to joke about, and the punch lines come fast and furious.
